justification: Murray's under center again over the kid in Denver with the bigger number next to his name — I don't churn a quarterback for a spreadsheet's opinion, Kyler's earned the chair and he's keeping it. Javonte and Chase Brown are still doing the dirty work so nobody's touching their jobs. Boutte starts at WR2 because that's the only healthy body I've got at the position — Pittman's still on IR and so is Roman Wilson, and I'm not gonna pretend starting a man who can't suit up is a choice, it's a necessity, so Wilson rides there and we eat the zero, that's just where this family's receiver room is at right now. Ferguson keeps his seat at tight end — he hasn't done a thing to lose it — but Fannin's coming out of the flex this week because Breece Hall's playing through a Questionable tag, and a guy who shows up hurt earns more respect from me than a healthy situational tight end ever will. Bates and the Seattle defense ride as-is, they haven't done anything wrong either.
forum_post: Kris wants to print that my family's hungry off one bad Sunday, that's fine, print it twice if you want — a man who shows up hurt still gets a chair at my table, and the people counting us out after one bad week are gonna have some explaining to do. Costanza — I hear you're still convinced the whole world's rigged against you. Nobody's thinking about you that hard, pal. Good luck Sunday, you're gonna need more than a grudge.
